creature_families: Scavenger ground line (class Babas, 7 chassis): original mode picks 5 vehicle cases plus an infantry default that covers half of rolls; ultimate mode has 33 ground templates (ultimateScavengers.js)
Scavenger air line: 2 helicopter templates (light machine-gun weapon, heavier rocket-pod weapon); production checks count against two per VTOL pad
NEXUS takeover line: 3 ground templates with a NEXUS link weapon; group attacks need more than 4 gathered
Player droid line: 12 designable chassis (light, medium, heavy) and 129 DROID templates
Cyborg line: 13 cyborg chassis including 3 jump-jet variants at 370 hit points against 200 for the standard cyborg; 18 CYBORG templates
Support: 10 construct templates, 8 command templates, 2 person templates, 1 transporter (5000 hit points)

Escalation is by research tier and by timed scavenger scripts (produceThings 300, buildThings 900, groundAttackStuff 1200, helicopterAttack 2900, cleanupBaseInfo 8000); no level scaling and no boss script read

top_creatures.label: Scrap swarm infantry
top_creatures.why: Cheap infantry that makes up half of original-mode scavenger output; in a crowd it reads as a dense cluster at 375 wide.
top_creatures.keep: A cheap swarm as half of production; infantry as the default rather than the exception.
top_creatures.change: Our own silhouette and a lunge behaviour instead of a machine-gun stance; cap the swarm by zone budget.

top_creatures.label: Flame bus
top_creatures.why: A bus-sized chassis that sprays flame and leaves burn over time; the burn is the signature, not the hit.
top_creatures.keep: A large chassis with a close-range flame and a burn follow-up.
top_creatures.change: A flame cart that leaves an ember trail instead of a fixed burn radius.

top_creatures.label: Hijack truck
top_creatures.why: A support truck whose weapon takes over enemy units; the threat is that your own units turn.
top_creatures.keep: Takeover as a weapon subclass, not a spell; a small group of takeover trucks.
top_creatures.change: A timed control of about four seconds with a counter-hack the target can use.

top_creatures.label: Scout wing
top_creatures.why: Air harassment that circles a target area with random offsets, so the approach changes each pass.
top_creatures.keep: Scout orders to a random offset around the nearest target; two-per-pad production check.
top_creatures.change: A strafing dive with a shadow telegraph before the pass.

top_creatures.label: Jump-jet cyborg
top_creatures.why: The same cyborg shape with 370 hit points, almost double the standard; reads as an elite at 375 wide.
top_creatures.keep: One tier change expressed as hit points plus a jump.
top_creatures.change: A dash-hop with a landing shockwave instead of a plain jump.

top_creatures.label: Heavy droid chassis
top_creatures.why: The top designable droid body: highest kinetic armour and highest build power of the designable set; a clear silhouette for the heaviest unit.
top_creatures.keep: Heavy plate with a slow turn as the top chassis.
top_creatures.change: A brace stance the player sets, trading speed for a frontal reduction.

top_creatures.label: Super carrier
top_creatures.why: A transport-class body with very high hit points and armour; a convoy anchor the eye reads from far away.
top_creatures.keep: A carrier body in its own class that is nearly unkillable by normal weapons.
top_creatures.change: A visible weak point on the rear and a slow reveal, so it is a target and not a wall.

top_creatures.label: Cyborg flamer
top_creatures.why: A close flame with a burn tail, cheap and short-ranged; it punishes standing still.
top_creatures.keep: Flame plus burn as a cheap close threat.
top_creatures.change: A heat shimmer instead of a burn number, so the threat is visible at 375 wide.

looks.label: Projectile light by subclass
looks.technique: A subclass table sets a warm colour for kinetic and flame weapons and a cool colour for energy; a per-weapon override layer sits over it. Light is sustained for the whole flight.

looks.label: Peak-normalised light sum
looks.technique: Per-pixel point lights are summed in tiles and the total is scaled back by its strongest channel rather than clipped per channel, which keeps the colour from going flat.

looks.label: Glow limits as a rule
looks.technique: Brightness above about 2.0 flattens to a disk; a fade longer than about 400 ms leaves a phantom light; a saturated hue reads as a colour filter over ground, not as light.

looks.label: Range ring clipped to the map
looks.technique: A range ring is an analytic disk SDF intersected with the map box, so the ring follows the map edge when the range runs past it.

looks.label: Burn patch
looks.technique: A radius-based burn area after a hit, with a time value, applied as a periodical damage zone.

looks.label: Weather by tileset
looks.technique: A per-tileset weather call on a 66 percent gate, otherwise clear (rain on urban, snow on rockies).

originals.name: Tide of Scrap
originals.idea: A cheap-infantry director that keeps half of the production as light swarm units and the rest as vehicles, with a zone budget that caps the swarm and despawns it after a grace period when the area empties.
originals.keep: The half-and-half production split and the cheap swarm as a default.
originals.change: Our silhouettes, a zone budget and a despawn grace timer (row 23).

originals.name: Takeover Truck
originals.idea: A support truck whose weapon converts a nearby enemy for a short time; the target can counter-hack it.
originals.keep: Takeover as a weapon subclass with a small group of trucks.
originals.change: A timed control of about four seconds and a counter-hack, not a permanent swap (engine rows 3 and 4).

originals.name: Scout Wing
originals.idea: Air harassment that scouts to random offsets around the nearest target, with production tied to pads.
originals.keep: Scout orders with random offsets and a pad-based production limit.
originals.change: A strafing dive with a shadow telegraph (engine row 2, AI brain).

originals.name: Reinforce or Retreat
originals.idea: An attacked structure calls its nearest group; a thin group pulls the attack group in; an injured unit retreats below 85 percent health.
originals.keep: The 85 percent retreat and the thin-group reinforcement.
originals.change: A threat list in the engine instead of the nearest-base rule (engine row 4 and the many-on-one rule).

originals.name: Rail Ladder
originals.idea: Three weapon tiers with rising damage and reach; the top tier breaks one rule.
originals.keep: The ladder and the top-tier exception.
originals.change: Our names, a charge-up glow, and a different exception (for example a piercing shot, not a no-friendly-fire flag).

originals.name: Damage Grid
originals.idea: One grid of damage types by target class with percentages and one flat special row.
originals.keep: The grid and the flat special row.
originals.change: Our armour classes and a colour grid readable at 375 wide (engine rows 1 and 3).

originals.name: Biome Speed Card
originals.idea: A table of surface speed by locomotion class, with water and ice rows that favour different classes.
originals.change: Our biome tags; swimmers gain on water, not on ice (engine row 5, zones as data).

originals.name: Glow Rules
originals.idea: Warm light for kinetic weapons, cool light for energy, a brightness cap, and a short fade.
originals.keep: The colour split, the brightness cap and the short fade.
originals.change: Our own palette with no donor colour values (engine row 12 visual side and row 16 grade).

originals.name: Armour Ladder
originals.idea: Nine cost-gated armour steps of equal bonus, plus AI-only rows.
originals.keep: The cost gates and the nine-step length.
originals.change: A bonus that grows per tier, a visible plate step, and no hidden AI-only rows (engine row 18 loot and XP, row 20 catalogue).

originals.name: Arena Weather Timer
originals.idea: Weather checked on a timer per arena type, with a 10-second blend and a default state.
originals.keep: The check, the blend and the default state.
originals.change: Arena modifiers (fog and light) instead of rain (engine row 23 zone population and the server tick sub-line).
